player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Agodifo {player_id} ({piece}). Opponent ne ({opp}). Fa mu sɛ '[b1 c3]' (firi → kɔ). Pieces nyinaa tu kɔ sɛ chess knights.
Muo biara a wɔfa no kyerɛ {score_per_capture} pɔint. Agodie no bɛba awiee wɔ {max_moves} muo anaa sɛ agodifo biara nni muo a ɛfata / nni pieces. Pɔint kɛseɛ no na ɛdi nkunim.
